text: Code every goal the answer mentions (multi-label). Then pick ONE main goal: (1) the goal the person marks as main ("mainly", "primarily"); otherwise (2) the first goal they state, skipping sentences that only give context. (3) In "I wanted X so that Y", X is the main goal and Y is an extra goal if it is an A code. (4) Reassurance (A7) follows the same first-stated rule: if it is written first, it is the main goal. (5) If the goal answer is vague, the goal-met answer may be used to find the goal. (6) If the first goal stated names no health question ("find credible information quickly", "cut down on leg work"), skip it and use the first goal that names a health question; if it says why AI was used, add the tag "Said why they used AI".
